pt.title: Auto Avaliar
pt.summary: Migração de um legado PHP para Node e React na GCP.

context.text: Plataforma com legado em PHP, em migração para Node e React na GCP.

work.text: Liderei tecnicamente a migração com strangler pattern, substituindo o legado por partes. No caminho: APIs REST e GraphQL, filas com DLQ, JWT e OAuth2, cache multinível, circuit breakers, SLOs e runbooks.

en.title: Auto Avaliar
en.summary: Migrating a legacy PHP system to Node and React on GCP.

context.text: A platform built on legacy PHP, moving to Node and React on GCP.

work.text: I was the technical lead on the migration, using the strangler pattern to replace the legacy system piece by piece. Along the way: REST and GraphQL APIs, queues with DLQs, JWT and OAuth2, multi-level caching, circuit breakers, SLOs and runbooks.

fr.title: Auto Avaliar
fr.summary: Migration d’un existant PHP vers Node et React sur GCP.

context.text: Une plateforme en PHP legacy, en cours de migration vers Node et React sur GCP.

work.text: J’ai assuré le lead technique de la migration avec le strangler pattern, en remplaçant l’existant brique par brique. En chemin : API REST et GraphQL, files avec DLQ, JWT et OAuth2, cache multiniveau, circuit breakers, SLO et runbooks.
